name: Entry Point Adjustment
aliases: Raycasting Volume Rendering with Entry Point Adjustment
definition: A volume rendering technique where the camera or volume is scaled such that the viewer enters the volume's bounding box. To prevent the view from disappearing when the camera position exceeds the back face of the volume, the ray entry point is dynamically shifted forward along the ray direction based on a scale coefficient.
summary: Entry Point Adjustment is a hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique that allows the camera to move inside the volume by dynamically shifting the ray's entry point forward, decoupling it from the geometric front face.
